zh: 每个操作的矩形都包含左下角，一个格子的值等于覆盖它的操作数；最大值就是 q，当且仅当这个格子被所有操作同时覆盖。
被所有矩形同时覆盖的区域本身也是一个以左下角为顶点的矩形，它的两条边长分别由所有 r 的最小值和所有 c 的最小值决定。
读入 q 组 (r, c)，分别维护 r 的最小值和 c 的最小值，输出两者乘积；乘积可达 10^18，要用 64 位整数。
en: Every operation's rectangle contains the bottom-left corner, and a cell's value equals the number of operations covering it; the maximum is q, reached exactly by the cells covered by every operation.
The region covered by all rectangles at once is itself a rectangle anchored at the bottom-left corner; its two side lengths are the minimum of all r and the minimum of all c.
Read the q pairs (r, c), keep the minimum r and the minimum c, and print their product; the product can reach 10^18, so use a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Each operation adds 1 to the rectangle from the bottom-left corner to (r,c); find the number of cells that end up holding the maximum value.

## Proof of correctness

The construction corresponds one-to-one with the definition in the statement; every input position/operation is handled exactly as defined, so nothing is missed and nothing is counted twice.
